title: Ayyanar
desc: Prabha, an idler, is always compared to his younger brother due to his careless attitude. However, when his brother gets killed, he joins a criminal gang to find the people who murdered him.

title: Amara Kaviyam
desc: Karthika and Jeeva, two college-going students, fall in love with each other but are forced to separate by their families. However, when they try to reunite, tragedy strikes.

title: Engeyum Eppothum
desc: Amudha, a village girl visiting Chennai for the first time, falls in love with Gautham, a stranger, who shows her around the city. Kathiresan, a metal worker, is infatuated by Manimegalai, a nurse.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Aasamiyin America Payanam
desc: Accused of murder, a young priest manipulates his associates to flee to America, secretly motivated by the desire to chase after the love of his life.

title: Pichaikkaran 2
desc: Sathya is a poor man in search of his sister, who has been kidnapped by human traffickers. However, an illegal brain transplant puts him in the shoes of a billionaire named Vijay.

title: Kaithi
desc: An ex-convict's fresh start to life is threatened by vengeful enemies, compelling him to confront the dangers for a chance at freedom.
